failedAttempts.symptom: The first verifier typecheck used a callback type narrowed to non-null after an earlier assertion, while a reactive query callback may receive null.
failedAttempts.resolution: Made the remediation observer callback explicitly accept the protected query's null result.

failedAttempts.resolution: Ran the same exact fresh target in a retained PTY session, verified it was ready, then ran the verifier.
